description: This file defines the InlinePrint class in the Twig templating engine, which provides a specialized expression node that compiles to a 'yield' statement for inline printing within Twig templates.

classes.name: InlinePrint
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractExpression used for inline print expressions in Twig templates, emitting a 'yield' during compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InlinePrint node with a given node and line number, also triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, outputting a 'yield' statement followed by the compiled sub-node.
